A '''battle''' was fought on a [[Lubang Minor]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] [[0 ABY/Legends|seven months after the Battle of Yavin]]. The Rebel forces arrived on the planet in order to establish a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] there, but the Empire followed them there. With the help of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Able|BL-1707]], who had been stranded on the planet since the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Rebel troops managed to escape.
